author: Tom Lewis
title: Jackson County postal worker sentenced to 59 days in prison for destroying mail - NewsBreak
text:
By Tom Lewis ,
4 hours ago
JACKSON COUNTY, Fla. (WMBB) - A Jackson County postal worker who threw away mail instead of delivering it is going to prison.
A federal judge sentenced 39-year-old Stacy Michelle Braxton to 59 days in prison and two years' probation.
In July, she pled guilty to one count of delay or destruction of mail. Braxton was a rural mail carrier out of the greenwood post office.
In February, law enforcement officers recovered almost 500 pieces of mail that had been tossed in a burn barrel in Marianna.
They were all addressed to people on Braxton's mail route.
When investigators questioned her, she admitted she threw the mail in the burn barrel and attempted to burn it rather than deliver it.
